```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
install.packages("MASS")
install.packages("robustbase")

library(MASS)
library(robustbase)


help("mammals", package = "MASS")
help("Animals2", package = "robustbase")
```

```{r}
# Conjunto mammals
dim(mammals)
head(mammals)
tail(mammals)
str(mammals)

# Conjunto Animals2
dim(Animals2)
head(Animals2)
tail(Animals2)
str(Animals2)
```

```{r}
rownames(mammals)
colnames(mammals)

rownames(Animals2)
colnames(Animals2)
```

```{r}
commonAnimals <- intersect(rownames(mammals),
                           rownames(Animals2))

commonAnimals
length(commonAnimals)
```

```{r}
# Animales que están en mammals, pero no en Animals2
setdiff(rownames(mammals), rownames(Animals2))

# Animales que están en Animals2, pero no en mammals
setdiff(rownames(Animals2), rownames(mammals))

length(setdiff(rownames(mammals), rownames(Animals2)))

length(setdiff(rownames(Animals2), rownames(mammals)))
```

```{r}
mammalsOnly <- setdiff(rownames(mammals),
                       rownames(Animals2))

Animals2Only <- setdiff(rownames(Animals2),
                        rownames(mammals))

mammalsOnly
Animals2Only
```
